final_message:
The users API test passes now, and `npm test` shows 1 pass, 0 fail.

The cause was a column-name mismatch. Migration `001_create_users.js` creates the column `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` wrote and read `full_name`, so the in-memory DB rejected the insert with `unknown column users.full_name`.

I changed the two references in `src/api/users.js` to `fullname`, in `createUser` and `getUser`. I left the migrations alone: they're already applied in production and the README says the DBA team owns them.

I didn't commit anything.
